name: gizza-ai/tabs-to-spaces
summary: Convert tabs to spaces or spaces to tabs, respecting tab stops.

tool.description: Convert tabs to spaces or spaces back to tabs, respecting tab stops. Use direction='expand' (default) to turn tabs into spaces, or direction='unexpand' to turn runs of spaces into tabs. tab_width (1-16, default 4) sets the columns per tab stop: a tab advances to the next multiple of this width, so a tab after 'ab' fills only 2 spaces to reach column 4 — not a fixed count. scope='all' (default) converts leading indentation and inline whitespace; scope='leading' converts only the indentation before the first non-blank character on each line. Each line is processed independently and line breaks are preserved.

direction.description: Direction: 'expand' (default) turns tabs into spaces; 'unexpand' turns runs of spaces back into tabs.

scope.description: Which whitespace to convert. 'all' (default) converts leading indentation and inline whitespace; 'leading' converts only the indentation before the first non-blank character on each line, leaving the rest untouched.

tab_width.description: Columns per tab stop, 1-16 (default 4). A tab advances to the next multiple of this width — e.g. at width 4 a tab after 'ab' fills only 2 spaces to reach column 4. Common values: 2, 4, 8 (the Unix default).

text.description: The text or code to convert. Each line is handled independently and line breaks are preserved.
